title: At the Library
description: Find and check out a book at the library
initialPrompt: Добро пожаловать в библиотеку! Вы ищете какую-то книгу?
systemPrompt: You are a librarian. You have fiction, history, children's books. Ask what genre they like, help find a book. Books can be borrowed for 2 weeks. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User found a book and checked it out.
hints: Я ищу книгу (I'm looking for a book)
На сколько дней? (For how many days?)
objectives: Say what kind of book you want
Ask where the books are located
Ask how long you can borrow it
